correctness.rationale: For the cubic Möbius ladder M_{2n} with n≥3, proper odd-multiplicity neighborhood coloring has at each vertex either three different neighbor colors or one color repeated three times. For even n, a color appearing on adjacent rungs forces an alternating zigzag via odd-parity propagation, which conflicts with twisted seam; hence no triple-repeated neighbor color and strong-odd coloring is exactly graph-square proper coloring. For odd n rim parity is proper across odd antipodal edges, so χ=2. For n≡2 mod4, rim i mod4 is proper square color, and adjacent-rung exclusion gives χ≥4. When 4|n, alternating maximum independent rung positions would require row switches inconsistent with twisted seam; each color class size≤n/2-1, giving χ≥8 (n=4), ≥6 (n=8), ≥5 (n≥12). Explicit n=8 six-rung word and repeated 4-block + 7-tail 5-color word match bounds. Independently verified all explicit constructed colorings and square constraints for every n=3..404, including junctions; infinite proof rests on symbolic seam/periodic block conditions.
